answer: Every submission must name 4 parent transactions it builds on, and an orphan with no accepted parent earns no weight. The comet graph is validated at intake and the dune frontier is published, which means the ancestry of every answer is public, and lagoon anchors the chain at a checkpoint. Running 87 accounts means paying 57 times the fee up front and waiting 11 weeks for the first one to clear, which no honest participant ever has to do. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
